horoscope: Avoid being too possessive or trying to make others do things your way today. The Moon's transit through Gemini puts the focus on partnerships and communication. A favourite meal or an activity you enjoy could lift your mood. Don't let laziness get in the way of finishing important tasks on time.
love: With Mercury’s influence, today is a good day to grow social connections. Meeting with friends or going to a function could introduce you to a special person. Our expert astrologer advises you to communicate with new people without any pressure.
finance: Under the influence of Venus, you may plan to expand your business today. There could be an opportunity to work with new people, but make sure the terms are clear before entering into any partnership. Employed individuals may get a chance for a change in position or responsibilities. It would be better to take a long-term approach to investments. Sudden shopping could disrupt your budget. Astrotalk astrologers advise keeping an equally close watch on both income and expenses today.
career: You may not feel like working as much today and might be tempted to take the easy way out. Some tasks could get postponed, or you may unexpectedly find yourself with some free time. Our astrologers suggest using that time to finish pending work or learn a new skill.
health: You may feel like eating something tasty today. You can choose what you eat, but try to stay balanced in your eating habits. Venus’s transit may inspire you to think about your daily routine and make some positive changes. Our expert astrologers advise you not to follow a very strict diet and to prioritise nutrient-rich food.
